notes:
Original acquisition: publisher preview only; no verified target full text. ResearchGate page advertised the target title but its available full text was a different 2019 paper, rejected. No values derived or converted. Replication uses its prespecified conceptual-knowledge ANOVA or procedural-knowledge rank transformation test; parallel conceptual rank-test results were not substituted.
Source follow-up: Extracted requested printed metric; no conversions. Requested eta-squared is printed as partial eta-squared; retained the printed metric.  Unassigned replication side and reported_success are placeholders; original-only validation. Source version: Published article. Title verified against supplied reference. Quotes preserve cached PDF text encoding (¼ denotes equals; h2p/ɳ2p denotes partial eta squared).
